fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Circular Driveway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Walkway
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the circular driveway clear of parked vehicles so fire and medical units can turn around without backing out to the street.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the structure to create clear working space for responders along exterior walls.
• Mark or unlock any rear gate to allow responders to reach the back of the property without returning to the front.
• Keep the walkway clear of obstructions so responders can move quickly between the driveway and the front entry.
• Post the property address visibly at the single driveway entrance, facing the direction of approaching traffic.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Ground Vegetation; Single Access Route; Limited Rear Access; Mixed Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or touch the roof and eaves.
• Thin trees in the cluster closest to the structure to open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Separate scattered shrubs from the base of large trees to reduce connected plant material between ground level and tree canopy.
• Cut back ground vegetation within the immediate area surrounding the structure.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches low enough to block a fire vehicle.
• Mark the entrance to the single access route clearly so it is visible to arriving emergency vehicles.
• Clear vegetation along the rear of the structure to allow movement around the full perimeter.
• Thin scattered trees on the sides of the driveway where branches extend over the travel lane.
• Remove dead material from within mixed vegetation areas that are close to the structure.
• Keep ground vegetation mowed or cut short in the open areas between scattered trees near the structure.
